claim: M1 is accepted and M2 Build Observatory is the sole active work.
negative_control: tools/human-review-index.py:a live row omitted from the generated view

claim: One registry classifies every public Make target, pre-commit stage, Docker stage, and analysis command.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:a public Make target absent from the registry

claim: One `make observe` interface generates help, listings, runs, comparisons, subsets, and recording.
Named `ONLY` and `SCENARIO` selection runs only the selected closure and cannot record partial results.
The observation schema retains exact source, environment, cache, command, sample, graph, and history identity.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:an observation missing a required member

claim: Cold, warm, cached, uncached, no-op, incremental, and bootstrap meanings are exact and non-overlapping.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:a scenario no command can run in

claim: Every cached sample retains its exact priming and isolated cache provenance.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:an unknown cache accepted as primed

claim: The complete canonical suite covers every important working-tree and staged pre-commit use case.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:a scenario no command can run in

claim: Mutating and repository-configuration commands run only in disposable or isolated environments.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:a mutating command run in the source tree

claim: The permanent command-surface validator fails on missing targets, stages, anchors, or classifications.
Per-module timing, the Dune graph, critical path, and downstream rebuild sets are reproducible.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:a dependency output with no module edges

claim: Git edit frequency, co-change, common edit shapes, and weighted rebuild cost use an exact retained range.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:weighted rebuild cost must retain BOTH inputs beside the product

claim: Local ad hoc bundles and the one tracked canonical observation use the same schema and implementation.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:a registry with the wrong schema

claim: Git-ref and local-path comparison reports exact deltas, ranges, compatibility, and added or removed metrics.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:an incomparable host class must not be reported as an ordinary percentage delta

claim: Recording requires a complete clean committed run and changes only the canonical observation file.
Measurement anchors and wrappers preserve normal command order, bytes, output, exit status, and side effects.
Every measured finding is assigned to M3, M4, or retain; M2 performs no optimization.
negative_control: tools/build-observatory.py:a command identified by source line number

claim: Proofs, theorem surfaces, extraction, transport, generated Go, goldens, and runtime behavior remain unchanged.
One exact M2 candidate carries the permanent facility and one canonical observation for that candidate.
